full_prompt_en: A square surreal photographic portrait shows a young woman standing frontally against a mottled green-gray wall. She is centered and seen from the waist upward, with dark hair parted exactly in the middle and braided into two long plaits. Her pale face looks directly at the viewer without a smile. She wears an olive-brown, old-fashioned dress or coat with a broad cream collar, a small dark necktie, and simple buttons down the front. Her hands are folded carefully at the lower center. Two large black birds perch on her forearms, one on either side of the torso. Their bodies angle toward each other, and their glossy beaks and layered feathers form a dark, almost symmetrical pair across her chest. The bird on the left stands more upright, while the one on the right reaches its head nearer the center and extends a longer tail downward. The wall behind them is softly textured, neither a distinct room nor a landscape. Dark olive and gray stains vary across its surface, becoming lighter behind the head and darker near the lower edges. Light is subdued and frontal, revealing the girl's eyes, collar, hands, and subtle feather edges while keeping the clothes and birds within a narrow shadow range. The palette is restrained to pale skin, cream, olive, charcoal, and muted green. The centered pose and paired birds create formal balance, yet the ordinary human stillness combined with the unusually calm animals makes the scene faintly uncanny. The finish blends photographic detail with painterly color grading and an aged, slightly scuffed surface.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、略带超现实感的摄影肖像呈现一名年轻女子正面站在斑驳绿灰墙前。她居中，从腰部以上入画，深发精确中分，编成两条长辫。浅色面孔不带笑意，直视观众。她穿橄榄棕色旧式裙装或外套，宽奶油色领、细小深领带，前襟有简单纽扣。双手小心交叠在下中央。两只大型黑鸟分别停在她两侧的前臂上。鸟身朝彼此倾斜，发亮的喙和层叠羽毛在胸前形成深色、近乎对称的一对。左鸟站得更直，右鸟把头伸向中央附近，较长尾羽向下延伸。背后墙面质地柔和，既不是明确室内，也不是风景。深橄榄和灰色污迹在表面变化，头后更浅，下缘更暗。光线低调而从正面进入，显出少女双眼、领口、手和细微羽缘，同时让衣服和黑鸟留在狭窄阴影范围。色彩严格限制于浅肤色、奶油色、橄榄、炭色和低饱和绿。居中的姿势与成对的鸟构成正式平衡，但寻常人的静止与异常驯静的动物并置，让场景微带诡异。完成效果把摄影细节、绘画般调色和略有刮磨的旧表面结合起来。
style_prompt_en: Surreal photographic portraiture combines precise frontal symmetry with restrained, weathered color. A mottled olive-gray ground, pale flesh and cream accents, and near-black paired shapes form a quiet limited palette. Soft frontal illumination preserves fine hair, fabric, feather, and skin texture without strong cast shadows. Keep the composition centered and still, with slight variations on either side preventing rigid mirroring. Painterly grading, subtle grain, and scuffed surface marks give the image the feel of an aged print. The atmosphere should remain calm, intimate, and gently uncanny.
style_prompt_zh: 超现实摄影肖像把精确正面对称和克制、风化的颜色结合。斑驳橄榄灰底、浅肤与奶油色重音，以及成对的近黑形状组成安静的有限调色。柔和正面照明保留发丝、布料、羽毛和皮肤细节，不造强烈投影。构图居中而静止，两侧有细小差别，避免僵硬镜像。绘画般调色、轻颗粒和刮磨表面让图像像旧照片。气氛保持平静、亲密，略带奇异。
theme_en: A solemn young woman in braids holding two black birds against a mottled wall
theme_zh: 一名梳双辫的沉静少女在斑驳墙前托着两只黑鸟
name: Maggie Taylor
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
